headline: The cutting keeps the last train.
body: A schoolbag leans against the hallway radiator, still zipped. The baker's shutter is half-raised and no one has spoken through it. We leave the kettle on the ring a minute longer than we need.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: even grey, no break, light from the east only

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: one wet tyre print, buses already stacked

pulses.label: Watch
pulses.value: 08:17 BST, radios on, doors not yet slammed
